personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean with 6 Glass / Luxe media player surfaces
personality_one_liner: A serene, professional, and fluid media experience that elevates the broadcast through minimal elegance and deep navy tones.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native padding for a minimal look. Use whitespace instead of borders to group items. Touch targets minimum 44x44pt.

do's: Use heavy glass effect for the persistent mini-player capsule above the bottom navigation rail.
Use glass effect for bottom-sheet headers and sticky section headers over scrolling content.
Ensure text on glass has a high-contrast underlying tint to guarantee readability.
dont's: Don't use glass on regular list rows, cards, or inputs.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Showcase the radio station with a strong CTA to listen live, recent podcasts, and latest news.

states.error: Failed to load feed. Retry button.

screens.layout: Hero section at top (logo, slogan, dark blue background with abstract blur or mic image, large 'Ascolta la Diretta' CTA). Horizontal scroll for 'Ultimi Podcast' (cards with imagery). Horizontal scroll for 'Ultime Notizie'. List at bottom for 'Programmi della settimana'. Scroll content must clear bottom padding for the persistent mini-player.

screens.name: Player (Mini & Full)
screens.purpose: A fluid media playback experience akin to Spotify/YouTube Music.
screens.layout: Mini-player: Floating rounded capsule anchored right above bottom tabs. Contains play/pause, small artwork, title, and green/red LIVE indicator. Full-screen Player (via bottom sheet or stack push): Massive square artwork with top gradient, large title, artist/show, playback controls (Play, volume, share), progress bar (for podcast) or pulsing LIVE tag (for radio).

screens.name: Podcast Library
screens.purpose: Browse, filter, and listen to past radio broadcasts and exclusive podcasts.
screens.layout: Top sticky header with search bar and filter chips (categorie). 2-column grid of podcast cover cards. Each card uses a gradient scrim if text is on the image, showing duration and play icon.

screens.name: Palinsesto (Schedule)
screens.layout: Day-of-the-week selector at the top (pill tabs). Vertical list of programs for the selected day. Each row shows time, program name, host, and a short description. 'On Air Now' row gets highlighted with brandPrimary tint or border.

screens.name: News Evangeliche
screens.purpose: Christian updates, missions, events, and testimonies.
screens.layout: List view of wide cards. Each card has a cover image (using expo-image + bottom gradient scrim) with title and date overlay, or side-by-side thumbnail layout.

screens.name: Richieste di Preghiera (Prayer Requests)
screens.purpose: A serene, private form for users to submit prayer requests.
screens.layout: A clean, single-column form with top instructions. Generous padding, inputs on surfaceTertiary. Sticky 'Invia' (Submit) button anchored to the keyboard.

hero_radio_live.alt: Podcast studio microphone with dramatic blue lighting

podcast_cover_placeholder.alt: Serene cross on rocks during sunrise

news_cover_placeholder.alt: Congregation praying in a church setting

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color tokens: use deep navy (brand/surface in dark mode) and light blue (brandPrimary) as the accent.

Implement a persistent mini-player. It MUST sit above the bottom tab navigation and below the scroll content. Add bottom padding to all main scrollviews to ensure content is not hidden by this floating player.
Use expo-blur heavily for the mini-player background to achieve the requested Spotify-like fluid experience.
Ensure 'Now Playing' full screen uses @gorhom/bottom-sheet or a fluid Stack push with shared element vibes. Make artwork huge, with a bold typography.
Do NOT use any default blue/purple colors that aren't defined in the JSON. Stick exclusively to the navy and azzurro specified in the JSON.
Do not use generic emojis anywhere in the UI.
Always apply a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to dark) when placing text over the hero image or podcast/news cover images.
Implement the 'LIVE' indicator clearly, either a pulsing green (#10B981) dot or red (#EF4444) dot next to the radio title.
